name: weather-conditions-journey
description: WEATHER-CONDITIONS journey. Exercises the two properties a screenshot sweep cannot: (1) the grade is scaled by the DAYLIGHT SOURCE, so at night it must be the exact identity — `src/scene/CLAUDE.md` rule 8, and the failure mode is an overcast pick silently dimming a lamp-lit room; (2) it applies in WALK mode and in the per-room EDITOR, which is a second canvas over the same store and therefore the classic place for a lighting change to be missing. Also crosses into Pro mode, since the flag is simple-tier and must survive the switch.

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setLightsMode?.('off'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setDeviceClass?.('capable'); s.hideLoading?.(); s.setFeatureFlag?.('interactiveDegrade', false) })()

steps.name: pin-device-class
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store; s.getState().setDeviceClass('capable'); s.setState({ setDeviceClass: () => {} }) })()

steps.name: lamps-really-off
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); for (const id of s.items.filter(i => i.props?.lightOn !== 'no').map(i => i.id)) s.toggleLightPower(id) })()

steps.name: walk-pose
steps.eval: (() => { window.__store.getState().setWalkFov?.(50); const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(10.9, 5.2); l.setYaw(0); l.setPitch(-0.02) })()

steps.name: probe-night-rain
steps.eval: (() => { const { scene } = window.__three; let sun = null, hemi = null, amb = null; scene.traverse(o => { if (o.isDirectionalLight && o.castShadow && sun === null) sun = o; if (o.isHemisphereLight) hemi = o; if (o.isAmbientLight) amb = o }); console.log('[probe] night rain ' + JSON.stringify({ hour: window.__store.getState().manualHour, weather: window.__store.getState().weather, sun: +sun.intensity.toFixed(5), hemi: +hemi.intensity.toFixed(5), ambient: +amb.intensity.toFixed(5), env: +scene.environmentIntensity.toFixed(5) })) })()

steps.name: probe-night-clear
steps.eval: (() => { const { scene } = window.__three; let sun = null, hemi = null, amb = null; scene.traverse(o => { if (o.isDirectionalLight && o.castShadow && sun === null) sun = o; if (o.isHemisphereLight) hemi = o; if (o.isAmbientLight) amb = o }); console.log('[probe] night clear ' + JSON.stringify({ sun: +sun.intensity.toFixed(5), hemi: +hemi.intensity.toFixed(5), ambient: +amb.intensity.toFixed(5), env: +scene.environmentIntensity.toFixed(5) })) })()

steps.name: probe-pro-flag
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); console.log('[probe] pro ' + JSON.stringify({ uiMode: s.uiMode, weatherConditions: s.featureFlags.weatherConditions, weather: s.weather })) })()

steps.name: probe-simple-flag
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); console.log('[probe] simple ' + JSON.stringify({ uiMode: s.uiMode, weatherConditions: s.featureFlags.weatherConditions, weather: s.weather })) })()
